surgery.en: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.
surgery.zh: 大部份的保险计划不包含整容手术。

spoon.en: Tom dropped the spoon into his pocket.
spoon.zh: 汤姆把汤匙放进了口袋。

sweat.en: He wiped the sweat from his face.

suit.en: Tom only wears a suit on special occasions.
suit.zh: 汤姆只在特殊场合穿西装。

soccer.en: His little brother is a famous soccer player.
soccer.zh: 他弟弟是个有名的足球选手。

space.en: The space race was an exciting time in history.
space.zh: 太空跑步是历史上激动人心的时刻。

saw.en: I haven't seen you for ages. Do you remember when I saw you last?
saw.zh: 好久不见了。记得上次我什么时候看见你的吗？

sunrise.en: We woke up very early in order to see the sunrise.
sunrise.zh: 我们起得很早为了看到日出。

smart.en: He is as smart as any other boy in the class.
smart.zh: 他和班上其他男生一样聪明。

sore.en: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
sore.zh: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。

sort.en: He was always annoyed in the city by noises of one sort or another.
sort.zh: 他在城市里一直受到噪音或者其他的干扰。

secret.en: This is a secret just between you and me, so don't let it slip out.
secret.zh: 这只是你和我之间的秘密，所以不要让它流出去。

special.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
special.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

shake.en: She stepped forward to shake his hand.
shake.zh: 为了握住他的手，她往前跨了一步。

shoulder.en: She rested her head on her mother's shoulder.
shoulder.zh: 她把头枕在母亲的肩膀上。

search.en: We have a warrant to search your apartment.
search.zh: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。

shame.en: It's a crying shame that they weren't insured against fire.
shame.zh: 这简直是太可惜了，他们没有买火险。

shut.en: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
shut.zh: 婚前张开眼，婚后半闭眼。

soup.en: A good cook doesn't throw out yesterday's soup.
soup.zh: 一个好的厨师不会丢掉昨天的汤。

system.en: I'm glad that they fixed the heating system, but now it's too hot.
system.zh: 我很高兴他们修复了暖气系统，但现在太热了。

strike.en: We're on strike because the company hasn't improved our wages.
strike.zh: 我们罢工是因为公司没有改善我们的工资。

slowly.en: Could you please speak a little bit more slowly?

serious.en: I don't think I've ever made any serious mistakes.
serious.zh: 我认为我没犯任何严重的错误。

stupid.en: I didn't think Tom would be stupid enough to do that.
stupid.zh: 我觉得，汤姆不会傻到那样做。

sale.en: First off, I'd like you to come with me to a department store sale.
sale.zh: 首先，我要你跟我一起去百货公司的特价活动。

skin.en: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.
skin.zh: 鲨鱼皮比金枪鱼皮粗糙多了。

smooth.en: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.

strength.en: The warrior is conscious of both his strength and his weakness.
strength.zh: 战士知道自己的力量和弱点。

success.en: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
success.zh: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。

shot.en: I shot the horse because it had trouble breathing.
shot.zh: 我枪杀了那匹马，因为他已呼吸困难。

stomach.en: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.
stomach.zh: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。

shoot.en: My camera can shoot high-definition video.
shoot.zh: 我的录像机可以拍高清视频。

saturn.zh: 许多卫星绕著土星运行。

surprising.en: I've something interesting to tell you that you might find surprising.
surprising.zh: 告诉你个好玩的事，能惊你一下。

staff.en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
staff.zh: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。

scar.en: I'll still have a scar from that accident.
scar.zh: 我还留着那起事故的伤疤。

sign.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.
sign.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。

share.en: For the time being, I must share this room with my friend.
share.zh: 眼下我不得不和我朋友同住这间房间。

suspicious.en: This statement is actually kind of suspicious.
suspicious.zh: 这种说法其实有点可疑。

speech.en: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
speech.zh: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。

save.en: The doctor tried every possible means to save his patient.
save.zh: 为抢救病人医生已尽力了。

sofa.en: This sofa can seat three people easily.
sofa.zh: 这张沙发起码可以坐三个人。

silent.en: Since he didn't know what to say, he remained silent.
silent.zh: 自从他不知道该说什么的时候，便一直沉默着。

social.en: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
social.zh: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。

stranger.en: I'm a stranger here myself. I'm afraid I can't help you.
stranger.zh: 我对这里不熟。恐怕我不能帮你。

style.en: Pizza is the kind of food that fits into today's life style.
style.zh: 比萨是种适合现在的生活方式的食物。

safe.en: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.
safe.zh: 你该把你的值钱物品保存在一个安全的地方。

sleeve.en: The men are wearing short sleeve shirts.

shed.en: Nobody's going to shed any tears if that old building gets torn down.
shed.zh: 没有人会为这个旧建筑物的拆除而落泪。

sandwich.en: I think you should eat a ham sandwich.
sandwich.zh: 我认为你该吃火腿三明治。

shower.en: I was caught in a shower and got drenched to the skin.
shower.zh: 我遇上了阵雨被淋得全身湿透。

stuff.en: Can't you move your stuff to the other room?
stuff.zh: 你不能把你的东西搬去另一个房间吗？

shopping.en: Tom almost always uses a credit card when he goes shopping.
shopping.zh: 汤姆在去购物的时候，几乎每次都会用信用卡。

sensitive.en: Cats' eyes are very sensitive to light.

succeed.en: We take it for granted that he will succeed in his business.
succeed.zh: 我们认为他的生意理所当然会获得成功。

spy.en: One of them is a spy.

sweater.en: Take a sweater with you so you don't catch a cold.
sweater.zh: 为了不感冒，请带上这件毛衣。

soap.en: They wash their hands with soap.

salt.en: She discovered that she had run out of salt.

shy.en: I was too shy to look her in the face.
shy.zh: 我害羞得不敢正面看她的脸。

soda.en: Do you want a glass of soda?

ski.en: I want to buy a pair of ski boots.

step.en: Step out of the car and place your hands behind your back.

sharp.en: His observations are sharp, but he doesn't say much.
sharp.zh: 他的观察是敏锐的，但他没有说太多。

sense.en: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
sense.zh: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。

sixty.en: My father will retire at the age of sixty.
sixty.zh: 我父亲六十岁就要退休了。

shave.en: I've got to shave before leaving.

seventeen.en: A boy of seventeen is often as tall as his father.
seventeen.zh: 十七岁的男孩常常长得和他父亲一样高。

stubborn.en: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.
stubborn.zh: 事实是倔强的，但统计是柔顺的。

silence.en: There was a minute of silence and then everybody started screaming.
silence.zh: 有一分钟的沉默，然后每个人都开始尖叫。

sentence.en: Will you please explain the meaning of this sentence to me?
sentence.zh: 您能为我解释这句句子的意思吗？

schedule.en: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
schedule.zh: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

situation.en: We were faced with an unusual situation because of the accident.
situation.zh: 那场事故让我们陷入了不寻常的局势。

sow.en: Farmers sow seeds in the spring.

salary.en: A trip to America was equivalent to a two-year salary for her.
salary.zh: 去美国旅行一次相当于她两年的工资。

stare.en: It isn't polite to stare at people.

sack.en: It's time to hit the sack.

suppose.en: Suppose you had a thousand dollars, what would you do with it?
suppose.zh: 假如你有1000美元，你会用它做什么呢？

spell.en: How do you spell your family name?

singer.en: I know Tom is a good singer, but I think Mary is better.
singer.zh: 我知道汤姆唱歌很好听，但我认为玛丽唱得更好。

switch.en: Switch on the light. I can't see anything.
switch.zh: 把灯打开。我什么都看不见了。

spread.en: English has spread all over the country.

sole.en: There was some chewing gum stuck to the sole of Tom's shoe.
sole.zh: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。

soil.en: The crash was and remains to date the deadliest airplane accident on Canadian soil.
soil.zh: 这起空难是迄今为止加拿大境内最严重的空难。

sigh.en: She gave out a sigh of relief.

sight.en: The baby caught sight of my ballpoint pen and reached out for it.
sight.zh: 这个婴儿盯著我的原子笔看, 并且伸手要拿它。

stock.en: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
stock.zh: 他在上个景气时期炒股攒下了一笔钱。

stewardess.en: A stewardess was rescued from the wreck.
stewardess.zh: 一名空姐从飞机残骸中被救出来了。

sweep.en: You have to sweep the floor.

strongly.en: I'm strongly opposed to a compromise.

stone.en: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.

sheet.en: Bring me a sheet of paper, please.

storm.en: Because of the storm, we had no choice but to stay at home.
storm.zh: 因为暴风雨的关系，所以我们必须待在家里。

sum.en: He anonymously donated a large sum of money to the Red Cross.
sum.zh: 他匿名向红十字捐了大笔钱。

skip.en: It's no crime to skip breakfast once in a while.
skip.zh: 偶尔不吃早餐也不会如何不好呀。

shovel.en: Tom is going to shovel the snow off the roof for us.
shovel.zh: 汤姆正要为我们铲掉屋顶上的雪。

stage.en: Are there any famous musicians on the stage?
stage.zh: 舞台上有著名音乐家吗？

square.en: The area of the factory is 1,000 square meters.

sew.en: Did you sew this by hand?

seldom.en: She visits the dentist on a regular basis, so she seldom gets toothaches.
seldom.zh: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。

stadium.en: A stage has been set up in the stadium.
stadium.zh: 体育场内已搭建起舞台。

sauce.en: His shirt was stained with sauce.
sauce.zh: 他的衬衫被酱汁弄脏了。

suitcase.en: Don't you want to see what I have in my suitcase?
suitcase.zh: 你不想看我的行李箱里有什么吗？

subway.en: In London, the police are always worried about finding a bomb on the train or subway.
subway.zh: 在伦敦，警察总是担心在列车或地铁上发现炸弹。

scientist.en: He was an excellent scientist, and what is more, was a great poet.
scientist.zh: 他是一位优秀的科学家，更是一位伟大的诗人。

speaker.en: I'm looking for a native speaker who could help me correct this essay.
speaker.zh: 我正在寻找可以帮我修改这篇论文的母语人士。

stick.en: Tom wrote his name in the sand with a stick.
stick.zh: 汤姆用棍子在沙上写了他的名字。

solution.en: There must be a way to arrive at a diplomatic solution.
solution.zh: 必须有外交解决的途径。

slice.en: Will you have another slice of pie?

solve.en: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.
solve.zh: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。

stream.en: A stream of people came out of the theater.

suspect.en: I suspect that they water down the beer in that pub.
suspect.zh: 我怀疑那家酒馆的啤酒兑水了。

swamp.en: I don't mean to swamp you.

sand.en: The old man loaded his mule with bags full of sand.
sand.zh: 老人在骡子的背上放上了一个个装满了沙的袋子。

separately.en: Could you wrap this separately, please?

suddenly.en: Nobody understood why the elephant suddenly turned on its owner.
suddenly.zh: 没有人明白为什么大象突然攻击了它的主人。

stew.en: Tom added broccoli to the stew.
stew.zh: 汤姆往炖菜里加了西兰花。

salad.en: Mary put some roasted pecans into her salad.
salad.zh: 玛莉在沙拉里放了一些烤山核桃。

scissors.en: These scissors are suitable for left and right-handed people.
scissors.zh: 这把剪刀左右撇子都适用。

speed.en: There are several ways to measure speed.

scare.en: I didn't mean to scare Tom.

sympathy.en: Everybody showed sympathy toward the prisoner.
sympathy.zh: 每个人都对囚犯表示同情。

spanish.en: I wish I could have spoken Spanish.
spanish.zh: 要是我会说西班牙语就好了。

scenery.en: Tom said the scenery was more beautiful than he thought it would be.
scenery.zh: 汤姆说，风景比他想像的还要美。

support.en: I don't expect that they will support my view.
support.zh: 我不期望，他们能够支持我的观点。

seriously.en: They say you shouldn't take rumors seriously, but that's easier said than done.
seriously.zh: 人们常说不要乱相信谣言，但说起来容易做起来难。

sleepy.en: I felt so sleepy that I could hardly keep my eyes open.
sleepy.zh: 我感觉困得几乎不能睁开我的眼睛了。

snake.en: Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.
snake.zh: 从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。

shock.en: She got over the shock of her father's death.
shock.zh: 她从她父亲过世的震惊中恢复了。

split.zh: 让我们平分这个报酬吧。

shade.en: There's no light without shade, and no shade without light.
shade.zh: 不存在没有阴影的光明，也不存在没有光明的阴影。

stitch.en: A stitch in time saves nine.
stitch.zh: 小洞及时补，免遭大洞苦。

soft.en: She was a tall, thin girl with long, soft brown hair.
soft.zh: 她是个又高又瘦, 留著一头又长又软的褐色头发的女孩。

slave.en: I refuse to be treated like a slave by you.
slave.zh: 我拒绝被你像奴隶一样对待。

selfish.en: It is true that she is pretty, but she is selfish.
selfish.zh: 她确实很漂亮，但她很自私。

sincere.en: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
sincere.zh: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。

survive.en: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
survive.zh: 那个地点的书店无法赚足够的钱生存下去。

slight.en: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.
slight.zh: 你不介意我关窗吧？我有点着凉了。

silver.en: Speech is silver, but silence is golden.

strawberry.zh: 我喜欢草莓味的冰淇淋。

security.en: Germany adopted a social security system in the 1880's.
security.zh: 德国在1880年代采取了一种社会保障制度。

sheer.en: It is a sheer waste of time.

safety.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
safety.zh: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。

salmon.en: Salmon lay their eggs in fresh water.

somewhat.en: Tom, Mary, John and Alice all looked somewhat surprised.
somewhat.zh: 汤姆、玛丽、约翰和爱丽丝都显得有些惊讶。

shape.en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.
shape.zh: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。

somehow.en: We have to have fun somehow.

sunset.en: Have you ever seen such a beautiful sunset?
sunset.zh: 你看过这么美的夕阳吗?

scholar.en: He is something of a scholar.

shelf.en: She put her CDs in a row on the shelf.
shelf.zh: 她把她的CD在书架上排成一排。

slightly.en: The tower leaned slightly to the west.

swear.en: I could swear there's something inside this box.
swear.zh: 我能发誓这箱子里有东西。

snack.en: What does Tom eat for a mid-afternoon snack?
snack.zh: 汤姆下午茶点心都吃什么？

sample.en: The sample is not pure enough.

sail.en: Tom is teaching me to how to sail.
sail.zh: 汤姆正在教我怎么开帆船。

sock.en: You've got a big hole in your sock.

shortage.en: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
shortage.zh: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。

soul.en: The man sold his soul to the devil.

signature.en: I attached my signature to the document.

scene.en: There were three uniformed police officers at the crime scene.
scene.zh: 犯罪现场有三名穿制服的警察。

slavery.en: Slavery is a crime against humanity.
slavery.zh: 奴役制是一种危害人类罪。

steal.en: Can you teach me how to steal?

silly.en: I need to ask you a silly question.
silly.zh: 我必须问你一个蠢问题。

score.en: He got a better score than us.
score.zh: 他得到了比我们还高的分数。

steak.en: I thought you'd be full after eating that big steak.
steak.zh: 我觉得吃完那块大牛排你就饱了。

string.en: A string of disasters struck the region.
string.zh: 一连串的灾难袭击这个地区。

subscribe.en: What newspaper do you subscribe to?

salesman.en: He makes a living as a salesman.

surrender.en: If Tom doesn't surrender, shoot him.
surrender.zh: 如果汤姆不投降，就开枪

successful.en: He thinks that only very well trained actors can be really successful.
successful.zh: 他认为只有训练有素的演员才能够获得成功。

separate.en: They sleep in separate bedrooms even though they're married.
separate.zh: 他们分房睡，即使他们已经结婚了。

sake.en: I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.

slippery.en: Driving on a slippery road can lead to a car wreck.
slippery.zh: 在光滑的路上开车会导致车祸。

steady.en: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.
steady.zh: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。

scarf.en: Tom tried to convince Mary to knit him a scarf.
scarf.zh: 汤姆想说服玛丽给他织一条围巾。

scholarship.en: Tom was able to go to college thanks to a scholarship.
scholarship.zh: 因为一份奖学金，Tom得以上大学。

scarcely.en: She had scarcely finished speaking when he cut in.
scarcely.zh: 她几乎没有说完话，就被他打断了。

signal.en: He gave us the signal to begin.
signal.zh: 他给了我们开始的信号。

shadow.en: She is afraid of her own shadow.

scientific.en: Dr. Yukawa played an important part in the scientific study.
scientific.zh: 汤川博士在科学研究上起了很重要的作用。

survival.en: I gave up all hope of survival.
survival.zh: 我放弃了所有生存的希望。

stake.en: I felt that my honor was at stake.
stake.zh: 我觉得我的名誉受到了威胁。

saving.en: His parents are saving for his college education.
saving.zh: 他的父母为他的大学教育存钱。

scrap.en: Please get me a scrap of paper.

strictly.en: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.
strictly.zh: 该国严禁进口稀有野生动物。

series.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
series.zh: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。

software.en: I'm having some problems compiling this software.
software.zh: 我编译这个程序有些困难。

shift.en: Tom is working the night shift.

strict.en: It's important to follow a strict diet.
strict.zh: 重要的是要遵循严格的饮食控制。

severe.en: Japan is confronted with severe economic problems.
severe.zh: 日本正面临著严重的经济问题。

surgeon.zh: 他是一个优秀的脑外科医生。

swift.en: Life is short and time is swift.

supply.en: When his food supply ran short, he had to look for a new place to live.
supply.zh: 他的食物供给不足的的时候，他不得不去找新的地方居住。

strain.en: Tom has been under a great deal of strain lately.

scent.en: The scent of cedar repels moths.
scent.zh: 雪松的气味可以驱赶飞蛾。

shampoo.en: What kind of shampoo do you use?

section.en: There are seven men and four women in my section.
section.zh: 在我的部门里有七男四女。

sausage.en: Have you ever seen sausage being made?

suffer.en: I can't bear to see animals suffer.
suffer.zh: 我无法忍受看着动物受苦。

seventy.en: He lived to be seventy years old.

spite.en: In spite of the heavy rain, he visited his friend in the hospital.
spite.zh: 尽管雨下得很大，但他还是去医院看望他的朋友了。

standard.en: JST stands for Japan Standard Time.

severely.en: I got scolded severely by that teacher.
severely.zh: 我被那位老师严厉斥责了。

sin.en: Is it always a sin to tell a lie?

skate.en: Is it safe to skate on this lake?
skate.zh: 在这个湖上滑冰安全吗？

skilled.en: My father is a skilled fisherman.

spot.en: The lake is deepest at this spot.

skeleton.en: The explorers discovered a skeleton in the cave.
skeleton.zh: 探险家们在洞穴里发现了骸骨。

sudden.en: All of a sudden, the enemy bombs came down on us like rain.
sudden.zh: 突然，敌人的炸弹像雨点一样落向我们。

source.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
source.zh: 互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。

sickness.en: She is absent because of sickness.

stress.en: Karaoke is good for reducing stress.

suitable.en: These scissors are suitable for left and right-handed people.
suitable.zh: 这把剪刀左右撇子都适用。

sensible.en: It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
sensible.zh: 你听从她的忠告是明智的。

shelter.en: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
shelter.zh: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。

steadily.zh: 价格一直在稳定地攀升。

safely.en: The boat was piloted safely into harbor.

sadness.en: Do you know what sadness feels like?

statue.en: The statue of Hachiko, the faithful dog, stands in front of Shibuya Station.
statue.zh: 忠犬八公的雕像伫立在涩谷站前。

satisfy.en: It is difficult to satisfy everyone.

spelling.en: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.
spelling.zh: 你得要更注意拼字和标点符号。

screen.en: Tom became popular among teenagers as soon as he made his debut on the screen.
screen.zh: 汤姆第一次上电视后就广受青少年的欢迎。

solid.en: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
solid.zh: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。

senior.en: She gave her seat to a senior citizen.
senior.zh: 她把她的座位让给了一个老人。

stir.en: I don't want to stir up old memories.
stir.zh: 我不愿意勾起久远的回忆。

sorrow.en: No words can express her deep sorrow.

sink.en: She put the dirty dishes in the sink.
sink.zh: 她把脏盘子放进水池里。

scandal.en: That scandal cost him his reputation.
scandal.zh: 丑闻让他付出了失去声誉的代价。

shell.en: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
shell.zh: 我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。

stove.en: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.
stove.zh: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。

souvenir.en: This will be a good souvenir of my trip around the United States.
souvenir.zh: 这将是我环绕美国旅行中一个很好的纪念品。

sometime.en: I hope we'll see each other again sometime.
sometime.zh: 我希望我们有时间还可以见面。

span.en: The life span of a butterfly is short.

slope.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
slope.zh: 这条小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

steep.en: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
steep.zh: 这条小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。

seaside.en: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
seaside.zh: 我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。

shore.en: I found a beautiful shell on the shore.
shore.zh: 我在海滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。

spray.en: Mary carries pepper spray in her purse.
spray.zh: 玛丽的包里有辣椒喷雾。

state.en: New York's Empire State Building is now running entirely on wind power.
state.zh: 纽约帝国大厦现在完全依靠风力发电。

slip.en: This is a secret just between you and me, so don't let it slip out.
slip.zh: 这只是你和我之间的秘密，所以不要让它流出去。

satellite.en: The moon is the earth's only satellite.
satellite.zh: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。

spark.en: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.

solar.en: The nearest star to our solar system is Proxima Centauri.
solar.zh: 离我们太阳系最近的恒星是比邻星。

statesman.en: The boy grew up to be a great statesman.
statesman.zh: 这个孩子长大后成为了一个伟大的政治家。

sadly.en: "He used to love me," she answered sadly.
sadly.zh: 他以前爱我，她伤心地回答。

swarm.en: A swarm of hornets attacked the children.
swarm.zh: 一窝黄蜂袭击了孩子们。

symbol.en: I don't know what this symbol stands for.
symbol.zh: 我不知道这个符号代表什么意思。

spoil.en: I don't want to spoil the ending for you.
spoil.zh: 我不想把结局提前透露给你。

swiss.en: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.

sketch.en: Tom ripped a page out of his sketch book.
sketch.zh: 汤姆从他的绘画本上撕下了一页。

steam.en: Water turns into steam when it is boiled.

starvation.en: The poor child was on the verge of starvation.
starvation.zh: 那可怜的孩子快饿死了。

stack.en: Tom put a stack of letters on Mary's desk.
stack.zh: 汤姆把一叠信放在玛丽桌上。

successfully.en: She successfully got him to tell the truth.
successfully.zh: 她成功地从他口中得知了真相。

subtract.en: Subtract three from eight and you get five.

statement.en: I would like to retract my previous statement.
statement.zh: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。

shortly.en: Shortly after the accident, the police came.
shortly.zh: 事故发生后不久，警察来了。

satisfactory.en: The explanation is by no means satisfactory.
satisfactory.zh: 这个解释不是很令人满意。

society.en: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.
society.zh: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。

superior.en: This carpet is superior to that one in quality.
superior.zh: 这地毯在质量上比那个好得多。

shrill.en: All at once she began to shout in a shrill voice.
shrill.zh: 突然间她开始用尖锐的声音大喊。

sneeze.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
sneeze.zh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。

structure.en: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.
structure.zh: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。

slang.en: It's fun to learn slang words in foreign languages.
slang.zh: 学习外语里的俚语很有趣。

spur.en: More money for education will spur economic growth.
spur.zh: 更多投资在教育的钱将会刺激经济成长。

soviet.en: The Cold War ended when the Soviet Union collapsed.

spear.en: The tip of the spear was dipped in a deadly poison.
spear.zh: 矛尖浸在一种致命的毒药里。

skill.en: Fluency in English is a very marketable skill today.
skill.zh: 流利的英语在今天是一种十分抢手的技能。

statistics.en: Facts are stubborn things, but statistics are pliable.
statistics.zh: 事实是倔强的，但统计是柔顺的。

surroundings.en: The rescuers searched the surroundings in hopes of finding the child.
surroundings.zh: 援救人员为了找到孩子，仔细搜索了那个区域。

subtle.en: There are subtle differences between the two pictures.
subtle.zh: 这两张图片之间有细致的差异。

shabby.en: In the end, we ended up eating at that shabby restaurant.
shabby.zh: 结果，我们在那破破烂烂的餐馆里吃了饭。

sacrifice.en: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
sacrifice.zh: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？

sufficient.en: I haven't yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
sufficient.zh: 我还没有收集到足够的材料来写一本书。

shark.en: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.
shark.zh: 鲨鱼皮比金枪鱼皮粗糙多了。

skyscraper.en: Burj Khalifa is currently the tallest skyscraper in the world.
skyscraper.zh: 目前哈里发塔是世界上最高的摩天大楼。

symphony.en: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
symphony.zh: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

sprinkle.en: I'll sauté a few sweet potatoes and sprinkle them with sugar.
sprinkle.zh: 我去炸一点红薯，然后在上面撒上糖。

senator.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
senator.zh: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。

shipment.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
shipment.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

situated.en: Switzerland is situated between France, Italy, Austria and Germany.
situated.zh: 瑞士位于法国、意大利、奥地利和德国之间。

starve.en: Do you know how many people in the world starve to death every year?
starve.zh: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？

stormy.en: I think it's dangerous to climb a mountain on a day when it's stormy.
stormy.zh: 我认为在有风暴的时候里登山很危险。

solo.en: Charles Lindbergh made the first solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in 1927.
solo.zh: Charles Lindbergh于1927年成功完成了第一次独自飞越大西洋。

stiff.en: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
stiff.zh: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。

slaughter.en: Many conservationists fear the continuing slaughter of whales is pushing these animals towards extinction.
slaughter.zh: 许多自然环境保护主义者担心持续屠杀鲸鱼正推动这些动物走向灭绝。
